formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   have x2 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate := List.map (fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => { op := x2.op, inputs := if x2.op.eval [Bool.false] = Bool.true then List.take (1 : ℕ) x2.inputs else x2.inputs : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate }) (List.drop (1 : ℕ) x1.gates);   have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate → Bool := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) => [(0 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)].any fun (x4 : ℕ) => x3.inputs.contains x4;   have x4 : ℕ := (List.filter x3 x2).length;   have x5 : Prop := ∃ (x5 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x7 : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x2 = x5 ++ x6 :: x7 ∧ (x6.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (0 : ℕ) ∈ x6.inputs ∨ x6.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ (9 : ℕ) ∈ x6.inputs) ∧ ∃ x8 ∈ x7, x3 x8 = Bool.false ∧ (10 : ℕ) + x5.length ∈ x8.inputs;   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x1 → (∀ (x7 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool), (x1.wires (List.ofFn x7)).getD (9 : ℕ) Bool.false = !x7 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ))) → x1.size ≤ (15 : ℕ) → (3 : ℕ) ≤ x4 ∨ (2 : ℕ) ≤ x4 ∧ x5 → (∃ (x10 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) (x11 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 (Fin.cons Bool.false x10) ≠ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 (Fin.cons Bool.false x11)) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize (8 : ℕ) (fun (x11 : Fin (8 : ℕ) → Bool) => PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (9 : ℕ) x1 (Fin.cons Bool.false x11)) (11 : ℕ)
plain_statement: Take an AND/OR/NOT fan-in-two circuit of at most 15 gates whose first gate (wire 9) is NOT x0 on every input; count the later gates that read wire 0 or wire 9 (a NOT read only at its first input). If at least 3 are counted, or 2 are and some AND reading wire 0 or OR reading wire 9 is read by a later uncounted gate, and the circuit's function with x0 fixed false is not constant, then that 8-input function has a fan-in-two circuit of at most 11 gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate NOT x_0 computes its edge function
